# Forgehand 0.2.5

Forgehand 0.2.5 keeps a merged pull request from interrupting completion checks for Issues it mentions.

**Pull request references are now reported as non-completions.** Historical text such as “Fixes #318” can point to a merged pull request instead of an Issue. Forgehand records that target as `not-an-issue`, leaves the pull request untouched, and continues checking any later Issue references from the same pull request. Actual read or planning failures still fail the run.

No adopter configuration changes are needed.

## Contributors

Mira: reproduced and repaired the completion-target handling, with an Action-entry regression covering a merged pull request followed by a valid Issue completion.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/forgehand/compare/v0.2.4...v0.2.5
